vscode-extension-halo.update: Overwrite current document with server version
vscode-extension-halo.upload-images: Upload images of this document to Halo
vscode-extension-halo.configuration.post: Publish the post by default when the frontmatter does not specify it (requires permission: publish own posts)
vscode-extension-halo.configuration.netw: Timeout in seconds for regular requests (post create/update/publish etc.)
Timeout in seconds for image upload and download
vscode-extension-halo.configuration.post: Slug generation strategy for new posts (frontmatter slug takes precedence)
vscode-extension-halo.configuration.imag: Transfer external images in the post to the Halo attachment library when publishing, in case the image hosts go away. The storage location can be changed via the 'Halo: Configure image storage policy' command; by default the location configured in Settings / Attachment / Personal Center attachment settings is used.
